== Maftufa a.k.a. Oz Zei Zantufa ==

''[http://selpahi.de/oz_plain.html lo se mànci te màkfa pe la .oz.]'' is a Lojban version of ''[https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/The_Wonderful_Wizard_of_Oz The_Wonderful_Wizard_of_Oz]'' translated by [[la selpa'i|Selpa'i]] in 2013.

The text conforms to an unofficial grammar.

However, no suitable parser were available to the public for a long time.

[[guskant|I ]]have just created the parser [http://guskant.github.io/gerna_cipra/maftufa-1.1.html '''Maftufa a.k.a. Oz Zei Zantufa'''] for the sake of readers of the artwork.

What [[guskant|I ]]understand about the form of the text of Oz possibly differs from that of the translator [[la selpa'i|Selpa'i]], but I tried to harmonize the grammar of the text with the meanings of original text.

[http://guskant.github.io/gerna_cipra/maftufa-1.1.html Maftufa_1.1] inherited the grammar from [[zantufa|Maltufa_1.1]] and then modified.

The properties of Maftufa are described below.

== Characteristic details of Maftufa that are different from the official grammar ==

=== Cmevla are tanru units ===
For example, <blockquote>
'''la nakfamti .xenris. ku''' 
</blockquote> should be parsed. 

(It is the same as [http://guskant.github.io/gerna_cipra/zantufa-1.1.html Zantufa].)

=== Selma'o NIhO can be accompanied by a connective ===
For example, <blockquote>
''broda'' '''ni'o ba bo''' lo cizra cu fasnu 
</blockquote> should be parsed.

Note that '''ni'o ba bo broda''' with no preceding paragraph is not grammatical: some preceding paragraph is necessary.

(It is the same as [http://guskant.github.io/gerna_cipra/zantufa-1.1.html Zantufa_1.1].)

=== Sentence connective can connect fragment and sentence ===
For example, <blockquote>
ni'o «lu lo vilcarbi'e ti muvdu doi .em. —sei xy fi lo speni cu cladu cusku— .i mi ba kurji lo danlu li'u» '''.i ba bo''' bajra fa'a lo ta'ozda noi lo bakni jo'u lo xirma cu se setca fi ke'a 
</blockquote> should be parsed.

(It is different from all versions of main [http://guskant.github.io/gerna_cipra/zantufa-1.1.html Zantufa]. [[zantufa|See the instructions of Zantufa.]] According to [http://guskant.github.io/gerna_cipra/zantufa-1.1.html  Zantufa_1.1], ''"lu'ei broda li'au i je brode"'' substitutes for ''"lu broda li'u i je brode"'' of Oz.)

=== Selma'o LU, TO, LUhEI can be followed by "JOI sentence" ===
For example, <blockquote>
ni'o '''«lu se ju''' lo do zdani cu co'e —sei lo cmalu ke tolci'o ninmu fau lo nu cisma cu cusku— .i je la'e di'u mintu .i ko catlu —sei ny fau lo nu degja'o lo kojna be lo zdani cu di'a co'e— .i lo re jamfu be ty cu za'o bancu fi lo cnita be lo mudri bliku li'u»
</blockquote> should be parsed.

=== Capital letters don't represent accentual sounds ===
For example, <blockquote>
KO CuRMI LO NU LA .DoROTIS.
CU KLaMA LA RI'oJME TCaDU
</blockquote> should be parsed.

(Only a preprocessing script was modified.)

=== Selma'o SE can be followed by selma'o FAhA ===
For example, <blockquote>
lo ckagai cu marji lo blanu bukpu .i je la .dorotis. cu panpi sipna '''se ru'u''' cy co'u lo cerni
</blockquote> should be parsed.

([http://guskant.github.io/gerna_cipra/zantufa-1.1.html Zantufa] also accepts it using simpler grammar.) 

=== Selma'o FEhE can be followed by selma'o PU ===
For example, <blockquote>
ni'o lo vi cange cu na sai simsa lo '''fe'e pu''' cange lo ka xamgu se kurji
</blockquote> and <blockquote>
ni'o '''fe'e ca''' ku no bitmu cu jibni lo klaji mlana .i je lo gugde cu rufsu gi'e nalzilplixa
</blockquote> should be parsed.

([http://guskant.github.io/gerna_cipra/zantufa-1.1.html Zantufa] also accepts it using simpler grammar.) 

=== "sentence I JA da ZOhU sentence" is grammatical ===
For example, <blockquote>
lo barda grufoi cu ragve lo bitmu '''.i je lo naldarno zo'u''' dy viska lo cpitepygau noi galtu zvati lo grana te zu'e lo nu fanta lo nu lo cipni cu jbibi'o lo makcu gurni 
</blockquote> and <blockquote>
ku'i mi na djica lo nu lo prenu mi te cmene zo bebna '''.i je va'o lo nu lo mi stedu cu stodi lo ka culno lo po'o sudysrasu jo'u nai lo besna zo'u:''' ta'i ma mi ka'e djuno su'o da
</blockquote> should be parsed.

(The main [[zantufa|Zantufa]] does not accept that form, which is not harmonious with logic.)

=== "NU GA da ZOhU jufra GI de ZOhU jufra" is grammatical ===
For example, <blockquote>
.i ku'i lo mi patfu pu pa roi klama ca lo nu mi nanla .i je py cu cusku lo '''se du'u ge clani nu litru pa'o lo ckape gugde gi ku'i bu'u lo zmadu be fi lo ka jibni lo tcadu poi la .oz. cu xabju zo'u lo gugde cu melbi'''
</blockquote> should be parsed.

([http://guskant.github.io/gerna_cipra/zantufa-1.1.html Zantufa] also accepts it using simpler grammar.) 

=== "bridi_tail gi ju'e bridi_tail" is grammatical ===
For example, <blockquote>
do me ma '''gi ju'e''' klama ma
</blockquote> should be parsed.

([https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1EZL03zPsuSkTaP3RrC_YTQR9WERwx_IAMHc66R38i4M/edit#gid=0 It is intended by the translator.] According to [http://guskant.github.io/gerna_cipra/zantufa-1.1.html Zantufa], [[zantufa jonma'o|"ju'e cu" would substitute for "gi ju'e"]].)

=== "LE tag mex broda" is grammatical ===
For example, <blockquote>
viska '''lo vi so'i smacu'''
</blockquote> should be parsed.

([http://guskant.github.io/gerna_cipra/zantufa-1.1.html Zantufa] fails to parse it, which is worth considering.)

=== A string of tags is a tag ===
For example, <blockquote>
mi pu ro roi jinvi lo du'u mi barda gi'e tsali '''.i to'e se ki'u bai bo''' lo tai cmalu dacti be mu'u lo xrula mi na ru'e mrogau .i je lo tai cmalu danlu be mu'u lo smacu cu nurgau lo mi nunji'e
</blockquote> should be parsed.

([http://guskant.github.io/gerna_cipra/zantufa-1.1.html Zantufa] also accepts it using simpler grammar.) 

=== "..." can substitute for "co'e" ===
For example, <blockquote>
ni'o lo cmalu nixli cu co'a klaku .i ny tai mutce lo ka nalfaudri .i je lo kanla cu za'u re'u '''...''' gi'e xanka catlu ny tai lo nu da'i la banli .oz. cu jinvi lo du'u ny ka'e sidju va'o lo nu da'i troci
</blockquote> should be parsed.

(Only a preprocessing script was modified.)

=== "selbri_2 ke'e be" can lack the preceding "ke" ===
For example, <blockquote>
mi do ba dunda '''lo brarai je xedrai je pamrai ke'e be''' lo ro risna pe lo mulno gugde pe la .oz.
</blockquote> should be parsed.

=== Selma'o JAI can tag a sumti ===
For example, <blockquote>
.i jai do co'u lo nu do zukte lo mi se djica cu na citka da
</blockquote> and <blockquote>
.i jai do ba cpacu lo risna
</blockquote> should be parsed.

The sentences above are translations of 
<blockquote>
"You shall have nothing to eat until you do as I wish." <br />
"you shall have a heart."
</blockquote>

However, differently from selma'o BAI, <blockquote>
pu se manci vlipa '''jai''' se gasnu
</blockquote> also should be grammatical.

([http://guskant.github.io/gerna_cipra/zantufa-1.1.html Zantufa] fails to parse it, which is worth considering.)

=== Cmavo su'i belongs to selma'o JOI ===
For example, <blockquote>
.i lo ro mei cu cadzu ze'a '''pi ro lo ca djedi su'i pi su'o lo bavla'i'''
</blockquote> and <blockquote>
.i ze'a '''lo donri su'i lo nicte''' mi litru pa'o lo vacri
</blockquote> should be parsed.

However, '''su'i''' can be also an operator because Maftufa has the same [[zantufa mekso|mekso properties]] as Zantufa.

== Assumable bugs of the text ==

Most part of the Oz text is parsed by Maftufa, though only the parts below are not parsed, or strangely parsed. I think they are not intended by the translator [[la selpa'i|Selpa'i]], and they are simply bugs.

Some people other than [[guskant|mi ]]created [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1EZL03zPsuSkTaP3RrC_YTQR9WERwx_IAMHc66R38i4M/edit?usp=sharing errata] long ago, which may include some of the items below.
